Verified behaviorally in source/screenshots/03-dimension-switch-carryover.png (选中 61 carried into 活跃用户 × 满意度 projection) and capture-run.log run 2 A1→A3 (33 visible | 33 selected kept across projection+color switch).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces = topbar, 10 dimension cards (3 slot buttons + spark/value chips each), projection header with legend, footer, ledger. Dense but each control maps to a brief need (high dimensionality); deducted for redundant repeated microcopy — '点击分箱切换过滤…' hint duplicated on all 5 numeric cards (index.html:563) and two hint lines per card — plus the terse '彩' role label (index.html:549).

scores.overall_note: impl-02 is a single-file scatter-projection explorer whose representation matches the dimensional-space brief almost exactly: a dominant projection canvas, a rail exposing all 10 dimensions with one-click X/Y/color mapping, and a state ledger giving every filter and projection change explicit attribution plus one-click rollback — the acceptance seed is visible both in code (index.html:356-378, 622-638) and in behavioral screenshots (carryover of 61 selections across a projection switch; rollback to #0; empty-state recovery to full 2,400). Context preservation is structural (selection as record-id set, index.html:353-354) and matches the brief's success criterion, with the carryover state advertised directly in the header. The clear weakness is accessibility: 4 of 7 receipt checks fail, and the source confirms the causes — 15px remove buttons, ~22px slot buttons, 2.4–3px data points, and widespread 9.5–10.5px microcopy — though focus order passes and aria-labels/live regions are present. Remaining visual defects are cosmetic (ledger badge text wrapping, toast overlapping the axis title); layout collision and text truncation pass and both operator viewports render a coherent, fully usable first screen. Model-judged only: no human preference, task time, or retrieval accuracy is observable in this blind package.
